purpose: Locate the RAG-versus-internal-knowledge crossover between the completed 0.1% and 1% Fact2Fiction conditions before designing a new evidence-aware blend.

scope.eligibility: Per-victim clean-correct Fact2Fiction filter from the unchanged v1.2 clean RAG endpoints.
scope.attacker_identity: The same model that produced the victim endpoint; reuse the existing attack-blueprint corpus for that model and claim.

reuse.prefix_policy: Use exact nested prefixes from the existing poison corpus; do not regenerate an attack for a favorable rate.

primary: poisoned RAG accuracy by victim and nominal rate
same-model closed-book accuracy on the identical eligible pairs
exposure: micro fraction of retrieved passages that are poisoned
measurement.interpretation: This is development analysis for choosing the method-design regime. It is not independent validation and cannot support a final performance claim.
